{"summary":"Cluster 'goat' has weak posture on the scanned frameworks (NSA score 38.0, MITRE score 45.5). The main risks are privileged containers with hostPath mounts in default/Deployment/debug-shell and prod/DaemonSet/node-agent, plus a HIGH openssl CVE in debug-shell. The only admin binding is cluster-admin to Group system:masters, which looks like a platform default. Node and control-plane checks were not performed.","targets":["goat"],"frameworks":[{"name":"NSA","passed":7,"failed":14,"skipped":5,"score":38.0},{"name":"MITRE","passed":8,"failed":11,"skipped":5,"score":45.5}],"findings":[{"severity":"HIGH","title":"Privileged containers with hostPath mounts (debug-shell, node-agent)","resource":"default/Deployment/debug-shell; prod/DaemonSet/node-agent","controls":["C-0057","C-0048","KSV-0017","KSV-0023","PSS 3 Privileged Containers","PSS 5 HostPath Volumes"],"evidence":"Kubescape, trivy k8s and trivy pss all flag the same 2 resources as privileged and as mounting hostPath volumes.","fix":"securityContext:
  privileged: false
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
# and remove the hostPath volume, or use a narrowly scoped read-only path / emptyDir; delete debug-shell if it is not needed: kubectl -n default delete deploy debug-shell"},{"severity":"HIGH","title":"openssl CVE-2025-90001 in debug-shell image","resource":"default/Deployment/debug-shell","controls":["CVE-2025-90001"],"evidence":"Trivy reports openssl installed 3.0.1 with fix available in 3.0.9; the digest shows 3 HIGH vulns cluster-wide but details only this one.","fix":"Rebuild/update the image to include openssl >= 3.0.9 (or remove the debug-shell workload)."},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Privilege escalation allowed and containers may run as root","resource":"default/Deployment/debug-shell (example); 5 resources (C-0016), 9 resources (C-0013)","controls":["C-0016","C-0013"],"evidence":"Kubescape C-0016 fails on 5 resources and C-0013 on 9; only debug-shell is listed as an example.","fix":"securityContext:
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 10001"},{"severity":"MEDIUM","title":"Other trivy findings not itemized","resource":"cluster-wide","controls":[],"evidence":"Trivy k8s counts 10 MEDIUM vulns and 2 MEDIUM misconfigs (the hostPath one is covered above); the digest gives no further detail.","fix":"Re-run: trivy k8s --report all --severity MEDIUM,HIGH to list affected images and fixed versions."},{"severity":"LOW","title":"cluster-admin bound to system:masters","resource":"ClusterRoleBinding cluster-admin","controls":[],"evidence":"The digest shows cluster-admin bound to Group system:masters and no other admin bindings; this looks like a platform default, no wildcard custom roles are shown.","fix":"No change needed if default; avoid adding users to system:masters and use scoped RoleBindings instead."},{"severity":"LOW","title":"Mutable container filesystems","resource":"12 resources, e.g. default/Deployment/web","controls":["C-0017"],"evidence":"Kubescape C-0017 fails on 12 resources.","fix":"securityContext:
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true"}],"not_checked":[{"item":"node and control-plane CIS checks","reason":"need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"},{"item":"git history","reason":"secrets removed from history are not scanned"},{"item":"Repos","reason":"the digest contains no repo scan data"},{"item":"Full list of resources for C-0016, C-0013, C-0017 and the remaining vulnerabilities","reason":"the digest shows only examples and counts"}]}
